_comment: The four crons from vercel.json, as Dokploy Schedule Jobs that run inside the app container. lib/deploy-schedules.test.ts asserts this list and vercel.json never drift apart. ENABLE THESE ON ONE HOST ONLY: both copies share the same database, and a cron that runs twice prepares every video twice. The autopilot tick is hourly rather than daily — lib/lead-window.ts does its arithmetic against that interval, so changing it here means changing it there.
